assets.transcript: In a campus library, our class tested an AI assistant that suggests articles for design projects. At first, the suggestions looked useful because the assistant found papers on the topics we entered. But when we checked the sources, several summaries missed important limits in the original papers. So our conclusion was narrower than we expected: the tool can help us find papers worth reading, but we still need to read each source before using it to support a design decision.

segments.label: 背景
segments.text: In a campus library, our class tested an AI assistant that suggests articles for design projects.
segments.meaningBasis: 场景与主题：校园图书馆里全班测试一个为设计项目推荐文章的 AI 助手。

segments.label: 最初有用
segments.text: At first, the suggestions looked useful because the assistant found papers on the topics we entered.
segments.meaningBasis: 最初印象的依据：按输入话题找到了论文，所以『看起来』有用。

segments.label: 发现问题
segments.text: But when we checked the sources, several summaries missed important limits in the original papers.
segments.meaningBasis: but 转折的对象：核查来源后发现，若干摘要漏掉了原论文的重要限制。

segments.label: 最终结论
segments.text: So our conclusion was narrower than we expected: the tool can help us find papers worth reading, but we still need to read each source before using it to support a design decision.
segments.meaningBasis: 最终评价（带限定）：能帮助找到值得读的论文；但支撑设计决策前必须自己读每篇来源——不是『不能用』也不是『随便用』。

assets.transcript: We made a map that tells visitors which rooms in the museum are busy. We expected people to choose a quieter route. In fact, some visitors walked toward the crowded rooms because they thought something interesting was happening there. The map was working as designed, but our assumption about what visitors wanted was incomplete. Next month, we will ask visitors why they chose a route before we change the design.

segments.label: 做了什么
segments.text: We made a map that tells visitors which rooms in the museum are busy.
segments.meaningBasis: 项目内容：一张告诉游客哪些展厅拥挤的地图。

segments.label: 预期
segments.text: We expected people to choose a quieter route.
segments.meaningBasis: 团队预期：人们会因此选更安静的路线。

segments.label: 实际观察
segments.text: In fact, some visitors walked toward the crowded rooms because they thought something interesting was happening there.
segments.meaningBasis: 实际行为与机制：有人反而走向拥挤展厅——因为他们以为那里有有意思的事。because 解释的是游客的动机。

segments.label: 判定
segments.text: The map was working as designed, but our assumption about what visitors wanted was incomplete.
segments.meaningBasis: but 对照的两件事：地图按设计正常工作 ↔ 团队对游客需求的假设不完整。失灵的是假设，不是地图。

segments.label: 下一步
segments.text: Next month, we will ask visitors why they chose a route before we change the design.
segments.meaningBasis: 后续计划：先问游客选路线的原因，再决定改不改设计。
